/// <summary>
/// ثبت توکن دسترسی کاربر (SSO/Pod) در جدول SSOTokens: اعتبارسنجی توکن و کلاینت صادرکننده،
/// تکرارنشدنی بودن ثبت و غیرفعال‌سازی توکن فعال قبلی همان زمینه (orchestrator/caller).
/// </summary>
[TestFixture]
public class RegisterAccessTokenCommandTests
{
    private const string PodToken = "pod-user-access-token";
    private const string ClientId = "pod-client-1";
    private const long OrchestratorSsoId = 31319816;
    private const long AgentThingSsoId = 45678901;

    private StubPodAuthService _podAuthService = null!;
    private FakeOptions<PodOptions> _podOptions = null!;
    private FakeAgentRepository _agentRepository = null!;
    private FakeSsoTokenRepository _ssoTokenRepository = null!;
    private RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler _handler = null!;

    [SetUp]
    public void SetUp()
    {
        _podAuthService = new StubPodAuthService();
        _podOptions = new FakeOptions<PodOptions>(o =>
        {
            o.ClientId = "mcp-client";
            o.ClientSecret = "mcp-secret";
        });
        _agentRepository = new FakeAgentRepository();
        _ssoTokenRepository = new FakeSsoTokenRepository();

        _agentRepository.Agents.Add(Agent(1, ClientId, AgentThingSsoId, isActive: true));

        _handler = new RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler(
            _podAuthService,
            _podOptions,
            _agentRepository,
            _ssoTokenRepository,
            NullLogger<RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler>.Instance);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Register_WithActiveTokenAndKnownClient_InsertsActiveRowAndReturnsReferenceId()
    {
        DateTime expiry = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(2);
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(expiry);

        RegisterAccessTokenDto result = await Register(PodToken, threadId: 12345);

        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Has.Count.EqualTo(1));

        SSOToken row = _ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Single();

        Assert.That(result.OrchestratorSsoId, Is.EqualTo(OrchestratorSsoId));
        Assert.That(result.CallerSsoId, Is.EqualTo(AgentThingSsoId), "شناسه SSO صاحب توکن از ایجنت همان ClientId خوانده می‌شود");
        Assert.That(result.ReferenceId, Is.EqualTo(row.Id), "ReferenceId همان Id ردیف ثبت‌شده است");
        Assert.That(row.OrchestratorSsoId, Is.EqualTo(OrchestratorSsoId));
        Assert.That(row.CallerSsoId, Is.EqualTo(AgentThingSsoId));
        Assert.That(row.AccessToken, Is.EqualTo(PodToken));
        Assert.That(row.ThreadId, Is.EqualTo(12345));
        Assert.That(row.IsActive, Is.True);
        Assert.That(row.ExpiryTime, Is.EqualTo(expiry).Within(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1)));
    }

    [Test]
    public void Register_WithInactiveToken_ThrowsAndInsertsNothing()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo.Active = false;

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<PodTokenIsNotActiveException>(() => Register(PodToken));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Is.Empty);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Register_WithExpiredToken_ThrowsAndInsertsNothing()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(-5));

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<PodTokenIsNotActiveException>(() => Register(PodToken));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Is.Empty);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Register_WithClientNotDefinedInAgents_Throws()
    {
        _agentRepository.Agents.Clear();
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        AgentNotFoundForClientIdException exception = Assert.ThrowsAsync<AgentNotFoundForClientIdException>(() => Register(PodToken));

        Assert.That(exception.ClientId, Is.EqualTo(ClientId));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Is.Empty);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Register_WithInactiveAgent_Throws()
    {
        _agentRepository.Agents.Clear();
        _agentRepository.Agents.Add(Agent(1, ClientId, AgentThingSsoId, isActive: false));
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<AgentNotFoundForClientIdException>(() => Register(PodToken));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Is.Empty);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Register_WithoutOrchestratorSsoId_ThrowsForbidden()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        RegisterAccessTokenCommand command = Command(PodToken);
        command.OrchestratorSsoId = 0;

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<ForbiddenException>(() => _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Is.Empty);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Register_SameTokenTwice_UpdatesSameRowAndReturnsSameReferenceId()
    {
        DateTime firstExpiry = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1);
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(firstExpiry);

        RegisterAccessTokenDto first = await Register(PodToken, threadId: 111);

        DateTime secondExpiry = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(3);
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(secondExpiry);

        RegisterAccessTokenDto second = await Register(PodToken, threadId: 222);

        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Has.Count.EqualTo(1), "ثبت مکرر همان توکن ردیف جدید نمی‌سازد");
        Assert.That(second.ReferenceId, Is.EqualTo(first.ReferenceId));

        SSOToken row = _ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Single();
        Assert.That(row.ThreadId, Is.EqualTo(222));
        Assert.That(row.ExpiryTime, Is.EqualTo(secondExpiry).Within(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1)));
        Assert.That(row.IsActive, Is.True);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Register_SecondTokenForSameContext_DeactivatesPreviousToken()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        RegisterAccessTokenDto first = await Register("pod-token-1");

        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        RegisterAccessTokenDto second = await Register("pod-token-2");

        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Has.Count.EqualTo(2));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Single(x => x.Id == first.ReferenceId).IsActive, Is.False);
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Single(x => x.Id == second.ReferenceId).IsActive, Is.True);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Register_PreviouslyDeactivatedToken_ReactivatesItAndDeactivatesCurrentToken()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));
        RegisterAccessTokenDto first = await Register("pod-token-1");

        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));
        RegisterAccessTokenDto second = await Register("pod-token-2");

        // بازگشت به توکن اول: همان ردیف فعال می‌شود و توکن دوم غیرفعال می‌ماند
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));
        RegisterAccessTokenDto again = await Register("pod-token-1");

        Assert.That(again.ReferenceId, Is.EqualTo(first.ReferenceId));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Has.Count.EqualTo(2));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Count(x => x.IsActive), Is.EqualTo(1), "در هر زمینه فقط یک توکن فعال می‌ماند");
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Single(x => x.IsActive).Id, Is.EqualTo(first.ReferenceId));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Single(x => x.Id == second.ReferenceId).IsActive, Is.False);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Validator_WithEmptyToken_IsInvalid()
    {
        RegisterAccessTokenCommand command = Command(string.Empty);

        Assert.That(new RegisterAccessTokenCommandValidator().Validate(command).IsValid, Is.False);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Validator_WithTooLongToken_IsInvalid()
    {
        RegisterAccessTokenCommand command = Command(new string('a', 2001));

        Assert.That(new RegisterAccessTokenCommandValidator().Validate(command).IsValid, Is.False);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Validator_WithNonPositiveThreadId_IsInvalid()
    {
        RegisterAccessTokenCommand command = Command(PodToken);
        command.ThreadId = 0;

        Assert.That(new RegisterAccessTokenCommandValidator().Validate(command).IsValid, Is.False);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Validator_WithValidRequest_IsValid()
    {
        Assert.That(new RegisterAccessTokenCommandValidator().Validate(Command(PodToken)).IsValid, Is.True);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Register_WithoutPodClientCredentials_Throws()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        var handler = new RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler(
            _podAuthService,
            new FakeOptions<PodOptions>(options => options.ClientId = "only-client-id"),
            _agentRepository,
            _ssoTokenRepository,
            NullLogger<RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler>.Instance);

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<ExternalServiceException>(() => handler.Handle(Command(PodToken), CancellationToken.None));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Is.Empty);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Register_SendsMcpClientCredentialsToPod()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        await Register(PodToken);

        Assert.That(_podAuthService.LastRequest, Is.Not.Null);
        Assert.That(_podAuthService.LastRequest.Value.Token, Is.EqualTo(PodToken));
        Assert.That(_podAuthService.LastRequest.Value.ClientId, Is.EqualTo("mcp-client"));
        Assert.That(_podAuthService.LastRequest.Value.ClientSecret, Is.EqualTo("mcp-secret"));
        Assert.That(_podAuthService.LastRequest.Value.TokenType, Is.EqualTo(PodTokenType.access_token));
    }

    private Task<RegisterAccessTokenDto> Register(string podToken, long? threadId = null)
        => _handler.Handle(Command(podToken, threadId), CancellationToken.None);

    private static RegisterAccessTokenCommand Command(string podToken, long? threadId = null) => new()
    {
        PodToken = podToken,
        ThreadId = threadId,
        OrchestratorSsoId = OrchestratorSsoId
    };

    private static PodTokenInfoDto ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime expiry) => new()
    {
        Active = true,
        ClientId = ClientId,
        Exp = new DateTimeOffset(expiry.ToUniversalTime()).ToUnixTimeSeconds()
    };

    private static Agent Agent(long id, string clientId, long thingSsoId, bool isActive) => new()
    {
        Id = id,
        Title = "agent",
        ClientId = clientId,
        ContactTypeCode = "test",
        ThingSsoId = thingSsoId,
        OwnerSsoId = 1,
        IsActive = isActive
    };
}

/// <summary>جایگزین دست‌ساز ISSOTokenRepository با شبیه‌سازی Identity دیتابیس (بدون هیچ پکیج Mock)</summary>
internal sealed class FakeSsoTokenRepository : ISSOTokenRepository
{
    public List<SSOToken> Tokens { get; } = new();

    private long _lastId;

    public Task<SSOToken?> GetActiveByContextAsync(long orchestratorSsoId, long callerSsoId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        => Task.FromResult(Tokens.FirstOrDefault(x => x.OrchestratorSsoId == orchestratorSsoId && x.CallerSsoId == callerSsoId && x.IsActive));

    public Task<SSOToken?> GetByContextAndTokenAsync(long orchestratorSsoId, long callerSsoId, string accessToken, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        => Task.FromResult(Tokens.FirstOrDefault(x => x.OrchestratorSsoId == orchestratorSsoId && x.CallerSsoId == callerSsoId && x.AccessToken == accessToken));

    public Task<SSOToken?> GetByIdAsync(long id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        => Task.FromResult(Tokens.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == id));

    public Task<IEnumerable<SSOToken>> GetAllAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        => Task.FromResult<IEnumerable<SSOToken>>(Tokens);

    public Task AddAsync(SSOToken entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        entity.Id = ++_lastId;
        Tokens.Add(entity);

        return Task.CompletedTask;

using Serilog;
using XBank.Mcp;
using XBank.Pod.ZooKeeper;
using XBank.Mcp.Infrastructure.EF;
using XBank.Mcp.Api;

var environment = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT");
string environmentName = environment.ToUpper() == "PRODUCTION" ? "" : $".{environment}";

var serilogConfiguration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
    .SetBasePath(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory())
    .AddJsonFile($"serilogSettings{environmentName}.json", optional: false, reloadOnChange: true)
    .Build();

Log.Logger = new LoggerConfiguration()
    .ReadFrom.Configuration(serilogConfiguration)
    .Enrich.FromLogContext()
    .CreateLogger();

try
{
    Log.Information("Starting XBank.Mcp application");

    var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

    builder.Host.UseSerilog();

    builder.Host.UseDefaultServiceProvider((context, options) =>
    {
        options.ValidateScopes = true;
        options.ValidateOnBuild = true;
    });

    builder.Configuration.AddJsonFile($"appSettings{environmentName}.json", false, true);
    builder.Configuration.AddJsonFile($"podSettings{environmentName}.json", false, true);

    if ((Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("Zookeeper_Enabled") ?? "").ToLower() == "true")
    {
        builder.Configuration.AddZooKeeper("MCP");
    }

    var startup = new Startup(builder.Configuration);

    Log.Information("Calling ConfigureServices");
    startup.ConfigureServices(builder.Services);

    WebApplication app = builder.Build();

    await CheckPendingMigrationsAsync(app);

    startup.Configure(app, app.Environment);

    app.Run();
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    Log.Fatal(ex, "Application terminated unexpectedly");
    throw;
}
finally
{
    Log.Information("Application shutting down");
    Log.CloseAndFlush();
}

async Task CheckPendingMigrationsAsync(WebApplication app)
{
    using var serviceScope = app.Services.CreateScope();

    var serviceProvider = serviceScope.ServiceProvider;

    var context = serviceProvider.GetService<McpDbContext>();

    try
    {
        var pendingMigrations = await context.Database.GetPendingMigrationsAsync();

        if (pendingMigrations != null && pendingMigrations.Any())
        {
            throw new Exception($"Pending Migration Exists. {string.Join(',', pendingMigrations)}");
        }
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        Log.Fatal(ex, "Error while checking pending migrations.");
        throw;
    }
}

using NUnit.Framework;
using XBank.Mcp.Application.Options;

namespace XBank.Mcp.Application.Tests.Configuration;

/// <summary>
/// قرارداد ساختار فایل‌های podSettings: تنظیمات احراز هویت در <c>Pod:Auth</c> و تنظیمات پلتفرم در <c>Pod:Core</c>؛
/// هیچ کلید قدیمی مستقیماً زیر <c>Pod</c> باقی نمانده باشد (چون <see cref="PodOptions"/> به <c>Pod:Core</c> بایند می‌شود).
/// </summary>
[TestFixture]
public class PodSettingsStructureTests
{
    private static readonly string[] SettingsFiles =
    {
        "podSettings.json",
        "podSettings.Development.json",
        "podSettings.Staging.json"
    };

    /// <summary>کلیدهای Resilience که هم سرویس Identity و هم سرویس Platform از Configuration می‌خوانند.</summary>
    private static readonly string[] ResilienceKeys =
    {
        "TimeoutInSec",
        "MaxConnectionPerServer",
        "PooledConnectionIdleTimeoutInMin",
        "PooledConnectionLifetimeInMin",
        "RetryCount",
        "AllowedExceptionCountBeforeBreaking",
        "DurationOfBreakInSec",
        "CircuitBreakerOptions"
    };

    /// <summary>کلیدهای بخش Auth که ثبت سرویس Pod Identity از Configuration می‌خواند.</summary>
    private static readonly string[] AuthKeys =
        new[] { "AccountServerUrl" }.Concat(ResilienceKeys).ToArray();

    /// <summary>مسیرهای توکن سرویس Thing که باید از Pod:Auth خوانده شوند (مقدارشان خارج از این ریپازیتوری تعیین می‌شود).</summary>
    private static readonly string[] AuthTokenPathKeys =
    {
        "CreateTokenPath",
        "GetTokenForThingPath",
        "GetThingPath"
    };

    [Test]
    public void PodSection_ContainsOnlyAuthAndCore([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement pod = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod");

        string[] unexpected = pod.EnumerateObject()
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .Where(name => name is not "Auth" and not "Core")
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(unexpected, Is.Empty, $"{fileName}: کلید قدیمی مستقیماً زیر Pod باقی مانده است: {string.Join(", ", unexpected)}");
        Assert.That(pod.TryGetProperty("Auth", out _), Is.True, $"{fileName}: بخش Pod:Auth وجود ندارد");
        Assert.That(pod.TryGetProperty("Core", out _), Is.True, $"{fileName}: بخش Pod:Core وجود ندارد");
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodAuth_ContainsAllIdentityKeysWithValues([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement auth = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Auth");

        foreach (string key in AuthKeys)
        {
            Assert.That(auth.TryGetProperty(key, out _), Is.True, $"{fileName}: کلید Pod:Auth:{key} تعریف نشده است");
        }

        Assert.That(auth.GetProperty("AccountServerUrl").GetString(), Is.Not.Empty,
            $"{fileName}: Pod:Auth:AccountServerUrl نباید خالی باشد");

        foreach (string key in AuthKeys.Skip(1))
        {
            if (key == "CircuitBreakerOptions")
            {
                Assert.That(auth.GetProperty(key).ValueKind, Is.EqualTo(JsonValueKind.Array),
                    $"{fileName}: Pod:Auth:{key} باید آرایه باشد");
                continue;
            }

            Assert.That(auth.GetProperty(key).GetInt32(), Is.GreaterThan(0), $"{fileName}: Pod:Auth:{key} باید مقدار مثبت داشته باشد");
        }
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodCore_BindsEveryPodOptionsProperty([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement core = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Core");

        string[] missing = typeof(PodOptions).GetProperties()
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .Where(name => !core.TryGetProperty(name, out _))
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(missing, Is.Empty,
            $"{fileName}: این ویژگی‌ها در Pod:Core نیستند و بایندینگ آن‌ها مقدار پیش‌فرض می‌گیرد: {string.Join(", ", missing)}");
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodCore_ContainsPlatformValues([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement core = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Core");

        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("PlatformServerUrl").GetString(), Is.Not.Empty,

        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("RetryCount").GetInt32(), Is.GreaterThan(0), $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:RetryCount باید مقدار مثبت داشته باشد");
        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("CircuitBreakerOptions").ValueKind, Is.EqualTo(JsonValueKind.Array),
            $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:CircuitBreakerOptions باید آرایه باشد");

            .Where(x => x.PropertyType == typeof(string) && x.Name.EndsWith("Path", StringComparison.Ordinal))

            .ToArray();

        string[] allowedKeys = AuthKeys.Concat(AuthTokenPathKeys).ToArray();

        string[] leaked = auth.EnumerateObject()
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .Where(name => !allowedKeys.Contains(name))
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(leaked, Is.Empty, $"{fileName}: کلیدهای پلتفرم نباید در Pod:Auth باشند: {string.Join(", ", leaked)}");
    }

    {
        string path = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, fileName);

        Assert.That(File.Exists(path), Is.True, $"فایل تنظیمات در خروجی تست‌ها کپی نشده است: {path}");

        using JsonDocument document = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));

        return document.RootElement.Clone();
    }

    private static JsonElement GetSection(JsonElement root, string path)
    {
        JsonElement current = root;

        foreach (string part in path.Split(':'))
        {
            Assert.That(current.TryGetProperty(part, out JsonElement next), Is.True, $"بخش «{path}» یافت نشد (قطعه مفقود: {part})");

            current = next;
        }

        return current;
    }

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR;
using XBank.Mcp.Application.Options;

namespace XBank.Mcp
{
    public static class OptionsExtensions
    {
        public static void RegisterOptions(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            services.Configure<GeneralOptions>(configuration);
            services.Configure<ToolSortFieldsOptions>(configuration.GetSection("FieldSortSettings:ToolSortFields"));
            services.Configure<TokenSortFieldsOptions>(configuration.GetSection("FieldSortSettings:TokenSortFields"));
            services.Configure<AgentSortFieldsOptions>(configuration.GetSection("FieldSortSettings:AgentSortFields"));
            services.Configure<TokenOptions>(configuration.GetSection("Token"));
            services.Configure<OAuthOptions>(configuration.GetSection("OAuth"));
            services.Configure<McpChatOptions>(configuration.GetSection("McpChat"));
            services.Configure<RedisOptions>(configuration.GetSection(RedisOptions.SectionName));
        }
        public static PodOptions RegisterPodOptions(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            var podOptions = new PodOptions();
            configuration.GetSection("Pod:Core").Bind(podOptions);
            services.Configure<PodOptions>(configuration.GetSection("Pod:Core"));

            return podOptions;
        }
    }
}

                p.RetryCount = Configuration.GetSection("Pod:Core:RetryCount").Get<int>();
                p.AllowedExceptionCountBeforeBreaking = Configuration.GetSection("Pod:Core:AllowedExceptionCountBeforeBreaking").Get<int>();

            services.AddUserHeadersDelegatingHandler();
            services.AddClientIpPropagationHandler();

            services.AddSingleton(typeof(IMcpRedisStore<>), typeof(McpRedisStore<>));

            services.AddKeyedSingleton<IConnectionMultiplexer>("McpRedis", (sp, key) =>
            {
                IOptions<RedisOptions> redisOptions = sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<RedisOptions>>();
                return ConnectionMultiplexer.Connect(redisOptions.Value.ToConfigurationOptions());
            });

            //Because Oauth.RedisStore is registered as Scoped
            services.AddScoped(typeof(IMcpOauthCodeMappingCacheService), typeof(McpOauthCodeMappingCacheService));

            services.AddHeaderMasker(options =>
            {
                List<string> headers = Configuration.GetSection("SensitiveHeaders:SensitiveHeaders").Get<List<string>>() ?? new List<string>();
                options.SensitiveHeaders = headers;
                options.MaskPercentage = double.Parse(Configuration["SensitiveHeaders:MaskPercentage"], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            });

            services.Configure<ForwardedHeadersOptions>(options =>
            {
                options.ForwardLimit = null;

                options.KnownProxies.Clear();
                options.KnownNetworks.Clear();

                options.ForwardedHeaders = ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedFor;
            });

            services.AddHealthChecks()
                .AddDbContextCheck<McpDbContext>(name: "Database", tags: new[] { "ready" })
                .AddRedis($"{Configuration["Redis:Endpoint"]},user={Configuration["Redis:User"]},password={Configuration["Redis:Password"]},resolveDns=True", name: "Mcp Redis", tags: new[] { "ready" })
                .AddRedis($"{Configuration["Identity:RedisUrl"]},user={Configuration["Identity:RedisUser"]},password={Configuration["Identity:RedisPassword"]},resolveDns=True", name: "Shared Redis", tags: new[] { "ready" });
        }

        public void Configure(IApplicationBuilder app, IWebHostEnvironment env)
        {
            app.UseExceptionHandler();

            // NSwag و Swashbuckle هر دو UseSwagger دارند؛ چون NSwag.AspNetCore هنوز رفرنس است، صریح صدا میزنیم
            SwaggerBuilderExtensions.UseSwagger(app);
            app.UseSwaggerUI(options => options.SwaggerEndpoint("/swagger/v1/swagger.json", "XBank MCP API v1"));

            var useHttps = Configuration.GetValue<bool>("UseHttpsRedirection");
            if (useHttps)
                app.UseHttpsRedirection();

            //todo
            app.UseCors("AllowAll");

            app.UseForwardedHeaders();

            app.UseMiddleware<BeforeAuthenticationLogMiddleware>();

            var environment = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT");
            if (environment.Equals("STAGING", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
            {
                app.UseSseJsonRpc();
            }

            if (env.IsDevelopment())
            {
                app.UseOpenApi();
                app.UseSwaggerUi3(options =>
                {
                    options.EnableTryItOut = true;
                });
            }

            app.UseRouting();

            app.UseAuthentication();
            app.UseAuthorization();

            app.UseMiddleware<RequestResponseLoggingMiddleware>();

            Console.OutputEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;

            app.UseEndpoints(endpoints =>
            {
                endpoints.MapControllers();
                endpoints.MapHealthChecks("api/health", new HealthCheckOptions()
                {
                    ResponseWriter = UIResponseWriter.WriteHealthCheckUIResponse
                })
                .RequireAuthorization(PolicyKeys.HealthCheckAdmin);
            });
        }
    }

"},{"callId":"chatcmpl-tool-8526bee03989c519","kind":"function_result","value":"using System.Text.Json;
using NUnit.Framework;
using XBank.Mcp.Application.Options;

namespace XBank.Mcp.Application.Tests.Configuration;

/// <summary>
/// قرارداد ساختار فایل‌های podSettings: تنظیمات احراز هویت در <c>Pod:Auth</c> و تنظیمات پلتفرم در <c>Pod:Core</c>؛
/// هیچ کلید قدیمی مستقیماً زیر <c>Pod</c> باقی نمانده باشد (چون <see cref="PodOptions"/> به <c>Pod:Core</c> بایند می‌شود).
/// </summary>
[TestFixture]
public class PodSettingsStructureTests
{
    private static readonly string[] SettingsFiles =
    {
        "podSettings.json",
        "podSettings.Development.json",
        "podSettings.Staging.json"
    };

    /// <summary>کلیدهای بخش Auth که ثبت سرویس Pod Identity از Configuration می‌خواند.</summary>
    private static readonly string[] AuthKeys =
    {
        "AccountServerUrl",
        "TimeoutInSec",
        "MaxConnectionPerServer",
        "PooledConnectionIdleTimeoutInMin",
        "PooledConnectionLifetimeInMin",
        "RetryCount",
        "AllowedExceptionCountBeforeBreaking",
        "DurationOfBreakInSec",
        "CircuitBreakerOptions"
    };

    /// <summary>مسیرهای توکن سرویس Thing که باید از Pod:Auth خوانده شوند (مقدارشان خارج از این ریپازیتوری تعیین می‌شود).</summary>
    private static readonly string[] AuthTokenPathKeys =
    {
        "CreateTokenPath",
        "GetTokenForThingPath",
        "GetThingPath"
    };

    [Test]
    public void PodSection_ContainsOnlyAuthAndCore([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement pod = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod");

        string[] unexpected = pod.EnumerateObject()
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .Where(name => name is not "Auth" and not "Core")
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(unexpected, Is.Empty, $"{fileName}: کلید قدیمی مستقیماً زیر Pod باقی مانده است: {string.Join(", ", unexpected)}");
        Assert.That(pod.TryGetProperty("Auth", out _), Is.True, $"{fileName}: بخش Pod:Auth وجود ندارد");
        Assert.That(pod.TryGetProperty("Core", out _), Is.True, $"{fileName}: بخش Pod:Core وجود ندارد");
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodAuth_ContainsAllIdentityKeysWithValues([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement auth = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Auth");

        foreach (string key in AuthKeys)
        {
            Assert.That(auth.TryGetProperty(key, out _), Is.True, $"{fileName}: کلید Pod:Auth:{key} تعریف نشده است");
        }

        Assert.That(auth.GetProperty("AccountServerUrl").GetString(), Is.Not.Empty,
            $"{fileName}: Pod:Auth:AccountServerUrl نباید خالی باشد");

        foreach (string key in AuthKeys.Skip(1))
        {
            if (key == "CircuitBreakerOptions")
            {
                Assert.That(auth.GetProperty(key).ValueKind, Is.EqualTo(JsonValueKind.Array),
                    $"{fileName}: Pod:Auth:{key} باید آرایه باشد");
                continue;
            }

            Assert.That(auth.GetProperty(key).GetInt32(), Is.GreaterThan(0), $"{fileName}: Pod:Auth:{key} باید مقدار مثبت داشته باشد");
        }
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodCore_BindsEveryPodOptionsProperty([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement core = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Core");

        string[] missing = typeof(PodOptions).GetProperties()
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .Where(name => !core.TryGetProperty(name, out _))
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(missing, Is.Empty,
            $"{fileName}: این ویژگی‌ها در Pod:Core نیستند و بایندینگ آن‌ها مقدار پیش‌فرض می‌گیرد: {string.Join(", ", missing)}");
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodCore_ContainsPlatformValues([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement core = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Core");

        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("PlatformServerUrl").GetString(), Is.Not.Empty,
            $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:PlatformServerUrl نباید خالی باشد");

        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("TimeoutInSec").GetInt32(), Is.GreaterThan(0), $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:TimeoutInSec باید مقدار مثبت داشته باشد");
        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("RetryCount").GetInt32(), Is.GreaterThan(0), $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:RetryCount باید مقدار مثبت داشته باشد");
        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("CircuitBreakerOptions").ValueKind, Is.EqualTo(JsonValueKind.Array),
            $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:CircuitBreakerOptions باید آرایه باشد");

        string[] paths = typeof(PodOptions).GetProperties()
            .Where(x => x.PropertyType == typeof(string) && x.Name.EndsWith("Path", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .ToArray();

        string[] emptyPaths = paths
            .Where(name => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(core.GetProperty(name).GetString()))
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(emptyPaths, Is.Empty, $"{fileName}: مسیرهای پلتفرم نباید خالی باشند: {string.Join(", ", emptyPaths)}");
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodAuth_DoesNotCarryPlatformKeys([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement auth = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Auth");

        // کلیدهای مجاز در Pod:Auth = کلیدهای Resilience سرویس Identity + مسیرهای توکن Thing
        string[] allowedKeys = AuthKeys.Concat(AuthTokenPathKeys).ToArray();

        string[] leaked = auth.EnumerateObject()
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .Where(name => !allowedKeys.Contains(name))
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(leaked, Is.Empty, $"{fileName}: کلیدهای پلتفرم نباید در Pod:Auth باشند: {string.Join(", ", leaked)}");
    }

    private static JsonElement Root(string fileName)
    {
        string path = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, fileName);

        Assert.That(File.Exists(path), Is.True, $"فایل تنظیمات در خروجی تست‌ها کپی نشده است: {path}");

        using JsonDocument document = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));

        return document.RootElement.Clone();
    }

    private static JsonElement GetSection(JsonElement root, string path)
    {
        JsonElement current = root;

        foreach (string part in path.Split(':'))
        {
            Assert.That(current.TryGetProperty(part, out JsonElement next), Is.True, $"بخش «{path}» یافت نشد (قطعه مفقود: {part})");

            current = next;
        }

        return current;
    }
}

using MediatR;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using XBank.Mcp.Application.Extensions;
using XBank.Mcp.Application.Options;
using XBank.Mcp.Domain.Exceptions.ApiExceptions;
using XBank.Mcp.Domain.Exceptions.McpExceptions;
using XBank.Mcp.Domain.Model;
using XBank.Mcp.Domain.Repositories;
using XBank.Pod.Identity.Auth;
using XBank.Pod.Identity.Auth.Dtos;
using XBank.Shared.Utility;

namespace XBank.Mcp.Application.Commands
{
    public class RegisterAccessTokenCommand : IRequest<RegisterAccessTokenDto>
    {
        public string PodToken { get; set; }

        public long? ThreadId { get; set; }

        /// <summary>سمت سرور توسط کنترلر از claim توکن امضا پر می‌شود و از بادی قابل تنظیم نیست</summary>
        [JsonIgnore]
        public long OrchestratorSsoId { get; set; }
    }

    public class RegisterAccessTokenCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<RegisterAccessTokenCommand>
    {
        public RegisterAccessTokenCommandValidator()
        {
            RuleFor(x => x.PodToken).NotEmpty().MaximumLength(2000).XssCheck();
            RuleFor(x => x.ThreadId).GreaterThan(0).When(x => x.ThreadId.HasValue);
        }
    }

    public class RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<RegisterAccessTokenCommand, RegisterAccessTokenDto>
    {
        private const double MaskedTokenPercent = 0.9;

        private readonly IPodAuthService _podAuthService;
        private readonly PodOptions _podOptions;
        private readonly IAgentRepository _agentRepository;
        private readonly ISSOTokenRepository _ssoTokenRepository;
        private readonly ILogger<RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler> _logger;

        public RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler(IPodAuthService podAuthService,
            IOptionsSnapshot<PodOptions> podOptions,
            IAgentRepository agentRepository,
            ISSOTokenRepository ssoTokenRepository,
            ILogger<RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler> logger)
        {
            _podAuthService = podAuthService;
            _podOptions = podOptions.Value;
            _agentRepository = agentRepository;
            _ssoTokenRepository = ssoTokenRepository;
            _logger = logger;
        }

        public async Task<RegisterAccessTokenDto> Handle(RegisterAccessTokenCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // شناسه فراخوان امضاشده سمت سرور تعیین می‌شود؛ نبودن آن یعنی توکن امضا claim موردنیاز را ندارد
            if (request.OrchestratorSsoId <= 0)
            {
                throw new ForbiddenException();
            }

            // اعتبارنامه کلاینت MCP برای فراخوانی token/info در سرویس Pod ضروری است
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_podOptions.ClientId) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_podOptions.ClientSecret))
            {
                throw new ExternalServiceException("Pod client credentials are not configured.");
            }

            PodTokenInfoDto tokenInfo = await _podAuthService.GetTokenInfoAsync(request.PodToken, PodTokenType.access_token,
                _podOptions.ClientId, _podOptions.ClientSecret, cancellationToken);

            if (tokenInfo?.Active != true || tokenInfo.Exp <= DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds())
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("RegisterAccessToken: توکن دریافتی غیرفعال یا منقضی است.");

                throw new PodTokenIsNotActiveException(Masked(request.PodToken));
            }

            Agent? agent = await _agentRepository.GetByClientIdAsync(tokenInfo.ClientId, cancellationToken);

            if (agent == null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("RegisterAccessToken: کلاینت صادرکننده توکن در جدول Agents تعریف نشده است. ClientId: {ClientId}",
                    tokenInfo.ClientId);

                throw new AgentNotFoundForClientIdException(tokenInfo.ClientId);
            }

            long callerSsoId = agent.ThingSsoId;
            long orchestratorSsoId = request.OrchestratorSsoId;
            DateTime expiryTime = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(tokenInfo.Exp).UtcDateTime;

            long referenceId = await RegisterTokenAsync(request, orchestratorSsoId, callerSsoId, expiryTime, cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation("RegisterAccessToken: توکن کاربر ثبت شد. OrchestratorSsoId: {orchestratorSsoId}, CallerSsoId: {CallerSsoId}, ReferenceId: {ReferenceId}",
              orchestratorSsoId, callerSsoId, referenceId);

            return new RegisterAccessTokenDto(orchestratorSsoId, callerSsoId, referenceId);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// ثبت تکرارنشدنی توکن: همان توکن → به‌روزرسانی همان ردیف، توکن جدید → غیرفعال‌سازی توکن فعال قبلی همان زمینه و درج ردیف جدید.
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<long> RegisterTokenAsync(RegisterAccessTokenCommand request, long orchestratorSsoId, long callerSsoId, DateTime expiryTime, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            SSOToken? registeredToken = await _ssoTokenRepository.GetByContextAndTokenAsync(
                orchestratorSsoId, callerSsoId, request.PodToken, cancellationToken);

            SSOToken? activeToken = await _ssoTokenRepository.GetActiveByContextAsync(
                orchestratorSsoId, callerSsoId, cancellationToken);

            // توکن فعال قبلی همان زمینه (غیر از همین ردیف) باید غیرفعال شود
            if (activeToken != null && activeToken.Id != registeredToken?.Id)
            {
                activeToken.IsActive = false;
            }

            if (registeredToken == null)
            {
                registeredToken = new SSOToken
                {
                    OrchestratorSsoId = orchestratorSsoId,
                    CallerSsoId = callerSsoId,
                    ThreadId = request.ThreadId,
                    AccessToken = request.PodToken,
                    ExpiryTime = expiryTime,
                    IsActive = true,
                    CreationTime = DateTime.UtcNow
                };

                await _ssoTokenRepository.AddAsync(registeredToken, cancellationToken);
            }
            else
            {
                registeredToken.ThreadId = request.ThreadId;
                registeredToken.ExpiryTime = expiryTime;
                registeredToken.IsActive = true;
                registeredToken.CreationTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
            }

            await _ssoTokenRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            return registeredToken.Id;
        }

        private static string Masked(string podToken) => (podToken ?? string.Empty).Mask(MaskedTokenPercent, '*');
    }

    /// <summary>شناسه ردیف ثبت‌شده در جدول SSOTokens به‌همراه دو شناسه SSO زمینه</summary>
    public record RegisterAccessTokenDto(long OrchestratorSsoId, long CallerSsoId, long ReferenceId);
}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace XBank.Mcp.Controllers
{
    /// <summary>سرویس‌های احراز هویت مصرف‌شده توسط سرویس‌های دیگر (با توکن امضاشده XBank).</summary>
    [ApiController]
    [Route("api/v1/auth")]
    public class AuthController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly IMediator _mediator;

        public AuthController(IMediator mediator)
        {
            _mediator = mediator;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// ثبت توکن دسترسی کاربر (SSO/Pod) برای مصرف ابزارها در MCP.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPost("registerAccessToken")]
        [Authorize(AuthenticationSchemes = XBankAuthenticationScheme.Signature)]
        [ClaimRequirement("MCP_RegisterAccessToken")]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(RegisterAccessTokenDto), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        public Task<RegisterAccessTokenDto> RegisterAccessTokenAsync([FromBody] RegisterAccessTokenCommand command, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // شناسه فراخوان امضاشده از claim خوانده می‌شود (نه از بادی) تا قابل جعل نباشد
            command.OrchestratorSsoId = GetOrchestratorSsoId();

            return _mediator.Send(command, cancellationToken);
        }

        private long GetOrchestratorSsoId()
        {
            string? ssoId = User.FindFirst(ClaimKeys.SsoId)?.Value;

            if (!long.TryParse(ssoId, out long orchestratorSsoId) || orchestratorSsoId <= 0)
            {
                throw new ForbiddenException();
            }

            return orchestratorSsoId;
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// ثبت توکن دسترسی کاربر (SSO/Pod) در جدول SSOTokens: اعتبارسنجی توکن و کلاینت صادرکننده،
/// تکرارنشدنی بودن ثبت و غیرفعال‌سازی توکن فعال قبلی همان زمینه (orchestrator/caller).
/// </summary>
[TestFixture]
public class RegisterAccessTokenCommandTests
{
    private const string PodToken = "pod-user-access-token";
    private const string ClientId = "pod-client-1";
    private const long OrchestratorSsoId = 31319816;
    private const long AgentThingSsoId = 45678901;

    private StubPodAuthService _podAuthService = null!;
    private FakeOptions<PodOptions> _podOptions = null!;
    private FakeAgentRepository _agentRepository = null!;
    private FakeSsoTokenRepository _ssoTokenRepository = null!;
    private RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler _handler = null!;

    [SetUp]
    public void SetUp()
    {
        _podAuthService = new StubPodAuthService();
        _podOptions = new FakeOptions<PodOptions>(o =>
        {
            o.ClientId = "mcp-client";
            o.ClientSecret = "mcp-secret";
        });
        _agentRepository = new FakeAgentRepository();
        _ssoTokenRepository = new FakeSsoTokenRepository();

        _agentRepository.Agents.Add(Agent(1, ClientId, AgentThingSsoId, isActive: true));

        _handler = new RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler(
            _podAuthService,
            _podOptions,
            _agentRepository,
            _ssoTokenRepository,
            NullLogger<RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler>.Instance);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Register_WithActiveTokenAndKnownClient_InsertsActiveRowAndReturnsReferenceId()
    {
        DateTime expiry = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(2);
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(expiry);

        RegisterAccessTokenDto result = await Register(PodToken, threadId: 12345);

        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Has.Count.EqualTo(1));

        SSOToken row = _ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Single();

        Assert.That(result.OrchestratorSsoId, Is.EqualTo(OrchestratorSsoId));
        Assert.That(result.CallerSsoId, Is.EqualTo(AgentThingSsoId), "شناسه SSO صاحب توکن از ایجنت همان ClientId خوانده می‌شود");
        Assert.That(result.ReferenceId, Is.EqualTo(row.Id), "ReferenceId همان Id ردیف ثبت‌شده است");
        Assert.That(row.OrchestratorSsoId, Is.EqualTo(OrchestratorSsoId));
        Assert.That(row.CallerSsoId, Is.EqualTo(AgentThingSsoId));
        Assert.That(row.AccessToken, Is.EqualTo(PodToken));
        Assert.That(row.ThreadId, Is.EqualTo(12345));
        Assert.That(row.IsActive, Is.True);
        Assert.That(row.ExpiryTime, Is.EqualTo(expiry).Within(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1)));
    }

    [Test]
    public void Register_WithInactiveToken_ThrowsAndInsertsNothing()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo.Active = false;

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<PodTokenIsNotActiveException>(() => Register(PodToken));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Is.Empty);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Register_WithExpiredToken_ThrowsAndInsertsNothing()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(-5));

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<PodTokenIsNotActiveException>(() => Register(PodToken));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Is.Empty);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Register_WithClientNotDefinedInAgents_Throws()
    {
        _agentRepository.Agents.Clear();
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        AgentNotFoundForClientIdException exception = Assert.ThrowsAsync<AgentNotFoundForClientIdException>(() => Register(PodToken));

        Assert.That(exception.ClientId, Is.EqualTo(ClientId));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Is.Empty);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Register_WithInactiveAgent_Throws()
    {
        _agentRepository.Agents.Clear();
        _agentRepository.Agents.Add(Agent(1, ClientId, AgentThingSsoId, isActive: false));
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<AgentNotFoundForClientIdException>(() => Register(PodToken));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Is.Empty);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Register_WithoutOrchestratorSsoId_ThrowsForbidden()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        RegisterAccessTokenCommand command = Command(PodToken);
        command.OrchestratorSsoId = 0;

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<ForbiddenException>(() => _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Is.Empty);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Register_SameTokenTwice_UpdatesSameRowAndReturnsSameReferenceId()
    {
        DateTime firstExpiry = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1);
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(firstExpiry);

        RegisterAccessTokenDto first = await Register(PodToken, threadId: 111);

        DateTime secondExpiry = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(3);
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(secondExpiry);

        RegisterAccessTokenDto second = await Register(PodToken, threadId: 222);

        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Has.Count.EqualTo(1), "ثبت مکرر همان توکن ردیف جدید نمی‌سازد");
        Assert.That(second.ReferenceId, Is.EqualTo(first.ReferenceId));

        SSOToken row = _ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Single();
        Assert.That(row.ThreadId, Is.EqualTo(222));
        Assert.That(row.ExpiryTime, Is.EqualTo(secondExpiry).Within(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1)));
        Assert.That(row.IsActive, Is.True);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Register_SecondTokenForSameContext_DeactivatesPreviousToken()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        RegisterAccessTokenDto first = await Register("pod-token-1");

        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        RegisterAccessTokenDto second = await Register("pod-token-2");

        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Has.Count.EqualTo(2));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Single(x => x.Id == first.ReferenceId).IsActive, Is.False);
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Single(x => x.Id == second.ReferenceId).IsActive, Is.True);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Register_PreviouslyDeactivatedToken_ReactivatesItAndDeactivatesCurrentToken()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));
        RegisterAccessTokenDto first = await Register("pod-token-1");

        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));
        RegisterAccessTokenDto second = await Register("pod-token-2");

        // بازگشت به توکن اول: همان ردیف فعال می‌شود و توکن دوم غیرفعال می‌ماند
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));
        RegisterAccessTokenDto again = await Register("pod-token-1");

        Assert.That(again.ReferenceId, Is.EqualTo(first.ReferenceId));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Has.Count.EqualTo(2));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Count(x => x.IsActive), Is.EqualTo(1), "در هر زمینه فقط یک توکن فعال می‌ماند");
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Single(x => x.IsActive).Id, Is.EqualTo(first.ReferenceId));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens.Single(x => x.Id == second.ReferenceId).IsActive, Is.False);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Validator_WithEmptyToken_IsInvalid()
    {
        RegisterAccessTokenCommand command = Command(string.Empty);

        Assert.That(new RegisterAccessTokenCommandValidator().Validate(command).IsValid, Is.False);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Validator_WithTooLongToken_IsInvalid()
    {
        RegisterAccessTokenCommand command = Command(new string('a', 2001));

        Assert.That(new RegisterAccessTokenCommandValidator().Validate(command).IsValid, Is.False);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Validator_WithNonPositiveThreadId_IsInvalid()
    {
        RegisterAccessTokenCommand command = Command(PodToken);
        command.ThreadId = 0;

        Assert.That(new RegisterAccessTokenCommandValidator().Validate(command).IsValid, Is.False);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Validator_WithValidRequest_IsValid()
    {
        Assert.That(new RegisterAccessTokenCommandValidator().Validate(Command(PodToken)).IsValid, Is.True);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Register_WithoutPodClientCredentials_Throws()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        var handler = new RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler(
            _podAuthService,
            new FakeOptions<PodOptions>(options => options.ClientId = "only-client-id"),
            _agentRepository,
            _ssoTokenRepository,
            NullLogger<RegisterAccessTokenCommandHandler>.Instance);

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<ExternalServiceException>(() => handler.Handle(Command(PodToken), CancellationToken.None));
        Assert.That(_ssoTokenRepository.Tokens, Is.Empty);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Register_SendsMcpClientCredentialsToPod()
    {
        _podAuthService.TokenInfo = ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1));

        await Register(PodToken);

        Assert.That(_podAuthService.LastRequest, Is.Not.Null);
        Assert.That(_podAuthService.LastRequest.Value.Token, Is.EqualTo(PodToken));
        Assert.That(_podAuthService.LastRequest.Value.ClientId, Is.EqualTo("mcp-client"));
        Assert.That(_podAuthService.LastRequest.Value.ClientSecret, Is.EqualTo("mcp-secret"));
        Assert.That(_podAuthService.LastRequest.Value.TokenType, Is.EqualTo(PodTokenType.access_token));
    }

    private Task<RegisterAccessTokenDto> Register(string podToken, long? threadId = null)
        => _handler.Handle(Command(podToken, threadId), CancellationToken.None);

    private static RegisterAccessTokenCommand Command(string podToken, long? threadId = null) => new()
    {
        PodToken = podToken,
        ThreadId = threadId,
        OrchestratorSsoId = OrchestratorSsoId
    };

    private static PodTokenInfoDto ActiveTokenInfo(DateTime expiry) => new()
    {
        Active = true,
        ClientId = ClientId,
        Exp = new DateTimeOffset(expiry.ToUniversalTime()).ToUnixTimeSeconds()
    };

    private static Agent Agent(long id, string clientId, long thingSsoId, bool isActive) => new()
    {
        Id = id,
        Title = "agent",
        ClientId = clientId,
        ContactTypeCode = "test",
        ThingSsoId = thingSsoId,
        OwnerSsoId = 1,
        IsActive = isActive
    };
}

/// <summary>جایگزین دست‌ساز ISSOTokenRepository با شبیه‌سازی Identity دیتابیس (بدون هیچ پکیج Mock)</summary>
internal sealed class FakeSsoTokenRepository : ISSOTokenRepository
{
    public List<SSOToken> Tokens { get; } = new();

    private long _lastId;

    public Task<SSOToken?> GetActiveByContextAsync(long orchestratorSsoId, long callerSsoId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        => Task.FromResult(Tokens.FirstOrDefault(x => x.OrchestratorSsoId == orchestratorSsoId && x.CallerSsoId == callerSsoId && x.IsActive));

    public Task<SSOToken?> GetByContextAndTokenAsync(long orchestratorSsoId, long callerSsoId, string accessToken, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        => Task.FromResult(Tokens.FirstOrDefault(x => x.OrchestratorSsoId == orchestratorSsoId && x.CallerSsoId == callerSsoId && x.AccessToken == accessToken));

    public Task<SSOToken?> GetByIdAsync(long id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        => Task.FromResult(Tokens.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == id));

    public Task<IEnumerable<SSOToken>> GetAllAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        => Task.FromResult<IEnumerable<SSOToken>>(Tokens);

    public Task AddAsync(SSOToken entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        entity.Id = ++_lastId;
        Tokens.Add(entity);

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public void Update(SSOToken entity) { }

    public void Remove(SSOToken entity) => Tokens.Remove(entity);

    public Task<bool> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken) => Task.FromResult(true);

    public Task<IEnumerable<SSOToken>> GetAllAsync(int size, int offset, string sortBy, SortMode sortOrder, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        => throw new NotSupportedException();
}

async Task CheckPendingMigrationsAsync(WebApplication app)
{
    using var serviceScope = app.Services.CreateScope();

    var serviceProvider = serviceScope.ServiceProvider;

    var context = serviceProvider.GetService<McpDbContext>();

    try
    {
        var pendingMigrations = await context.Database.GetPendingMigrationsAsync();

        if (pendingMigrations != null && pendingMigrations.Any())
        {
            throw new Exception($"Pending Migration Exists. {string.Join(',', pendingMigrations)}");
        }
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        Log.Fatal(ex, "Error while checking pending migrations.");
        throw;
    }
}

using NUnit.Framework;
using XBank.Mcp.Application.Options;

namespace XBank.Mcp.Application.Tests.Configuration;

/// <summary>
/// قرارداد ساختار فایل‌های podSettings: تنظیمات احراز هویت در <c>Pod:Auth</c> و تنظیمات پلتفرم در <c>Pod:Core</c>؛
/// هیچ کلید قدیمی مستقیماً زیر <c>Pod</c> باقی نمانده باشد (چون <see cref="PodOptions"/> به <c>Pod:Core</c> بایند می‌شود).
/// </summary>
[TestFixture]
public class PodSettingsStructureTests
{
    private static readonly string[] SettingsFiles =
    {
        "podSettings.json",
        "podSettings.Development.json",
        "podSettings.Staging.json"
    };

    /// <summary>کلیدهای Resilience که هم سرویس Identity و هم سرویس Platform از Configuration می‌خوانند.</summary>
    private static readonly string[] ResilienceKeys =
    {
        "TimeoutInSec",
        "MaxConnectionPerServer",
        "PooledConnectionIdleTimeoutInMin",
        "PooledConnectionLifetimeInMin",
        "RetryCount",
        "AllowedExceptionCountBeforeBreaking",
        "DurationOfBreakInSec",
        "CircuitBreakerOptions"
    };

    /// <summary>کلیدهای بخش Auth که ثبت سرویس Pod Identity از Configuration می‌خواند.</summary>
    private static readonly string[] AuthKeys =
        new[] { "AccountServerUrl" }.Concat(ResilienceKeys).ToArray();

    /// <summary>مسیرهای توکن سرویس Thing که باید از Pod:Auth خوانده شوند (مقدارشان خارج از این ریپازیتوری تعیین می‌شود).</summary>
    private static readonly string[] AuthTokenPathKeys =
    {
        "CreateTokenPath",
        "GetTokenForThingPath",
        "GetThingPath"
    };

    [Test]
    public void PodSection_ContainsOnlyAuthAndCore([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement pod = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod");

        string[] unexpected = pod.EnumerateObject()
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .Where(name => name is not "Auth" and not "Core")
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(unexpected, Is.Empty, $"{fileName}: کلید قدیمی مستقیماً زیر Pod باقی مانده است: {string.Join(", ", unexpected)}");
        Assert.That(pod.TryGetProperty("Auth", out _), Is.True, $"{fileName}: بخش Pod:Auth وجود ندارد");
        Assert.That(pod.TryGetProperty("Core", out _), Is.True, $"{fileName}: بخش Pod:Core وجود ندارد");
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodAuth_ContainsAllIdentityKeysWithValues([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement auth = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Auth");

        foreach (string key in AuthKeys)
        {
            Assert.That(auth.TryGetProperty(key, out _), Is.True, $"{fileName}: کلید Pod:Auth:{key} تعریف نشده است");
        }

        Assert.That(auth.GetProperty("AccountServerUrl").GetString(), Is.Not.Empty,
            $"{fileName}: Pod:Auth:AccountServerUrl نباید خالی باشد");

        foreach (string key in AuthKeys.Skip(1))
        {
            if (key == "CircuitBreakerOptions")
            {
                Assert.That(auth.GetProperty(key).ValueKind, Is.EqualTo(JsonValueKind.Array),
                    $"{fileName}: Pod:Auth:{key} باید آرایه باشد");
                continue;
            }

            Assert.That(auth.GetProperty(key).GetInt32(), Is.GreaterThan(0), $"{fileName}: Pod:Auth:{key} باید مقدار مثبت داشته باشد");
        }
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodCore_BindsEveryPodOptionsProperty([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement core = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Core");

        string[] missing = typeof(PodOptions).GetProperties()
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .Where(name => !core.TryGetProperty(name, out _))
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(missing, Is.Empty,
            $"{fileName}: این ویژگی‌ها در Pod:Core نیستند و بایندینگ آن‌ها مقدار پیش‌فرض می‌گیرد: {string.Join(", ", missing)}");
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodCore_ContainsPlatformValues([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement core = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Core");

        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("PlatformServerUrl").GetString(), Is.Not.Empty,
            $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:PlatformServerUrl نباید خالی باشد");

        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("TimeoutInSec").GetInt32(), Is.GreaterThan(0), $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:TimeoutInSec باید مقدار مثبت داشته باشد");
        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("RetryCount").GetInt32(), Is.GreaterThan(0), $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:RetryCount باید مقدار مثبت داشته باشد");
        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("CircuitBreakerOptions").ValueKind, Is.EqualTo(JsonValueKind.Array),
            $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:CircuitBreakerOptions باید آرایه باشد");

        string[] paths = typeof(PodOptions).GetProperties()
            .Where(x => x.PropertyType == typeof(string) && x.Name.EndsWith("Path", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .ToArray();

        string[] emptyPaths = paths
            .Where(name => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(core.GetProperty(name).GetString()))
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(emptyPaths, Is.Empty, $"{fileName}: مسیرهای پلتفرم نباید خالی باشند: {string.Join(", ", emptyPaths)}");
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodAuth_DoesNotCarryPlatformKeys([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement auth = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Auth");

        // کلیدهای مجاز در Pod:Auth = کلیدهای Resilience سرویس Identity + مسیرهای توکن Thing
        string[] allowedKeys = AuthKeys.Concat(AuthTokenPathKeys).ToArray();

        string[] leaked = auth.EnumerateObject()
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .Where(name => !allowedKeys.Contains(name))
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(leaked, Is.Empty, $"{fileName}: کلیدهای پلتفرم نباید در Pod:Auth باشند: {string.Join(", ", leaked)}");
    }

    private static JsonElement Root(string fileName)
    {
        string path = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, fileName);

        Assert.That(File.Exists(path), Is.True, $"فایل تنظیمات در خروجی تست‌ها کپی نشده است: {path}");

        using JsonDocument document = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));

        return document.RootElement.Clone();
    }

    private static JsonElement GetSection(JsonElement root, string path)
    {
        JsonElement current = root;

        foreach (string part in path.Split(':'))
        {
            Assert.That(current.TryGetProperty(part, out JsonElement next), Is.True, $"بخش «{path}» یافت نشد (قطعه مفقود: {part})");

            current = next;
        }

        return current;
    }
}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR;
using XBank.Mcp.Application.Options;

namespace XBank.Mcp
{
    public static class OptionsExtensions
    {
        public static void RegisterOptions(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            services.Configure<GeneralOptions>(configuration);
            services.Configure<ToolSortFieldsOptions>(configuration.GetSection("FieldSortSettings:ToolSortFields"));
            services.Configure<TokenSortFieldsOptions>(configuration.GetSection("FieldSortSettings:TokenSortFields"));
            services.Configure<AgentSortFieldsOptions>(configuration.GetSection("FieldSortSettings:AgentSortFields"));
            services.Configure<TokenOptions>(configuration.GetSection("Token"));
            services.Configure<OAuthOptions>(configuration.GetSection("OAuth"));
            services.Configure<McpChatOptions>(configuration.GetSection("McpChat"));
            services.Configure<RedisOptions>(configuration.GetSection(RedisOptions.SectionName));
        }
        public static PodOptions RegisterPodOptions(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            var podOptions = new PodOptions();
            configuration.GetSection("Pod:Core").Bind(podOptions);
            services.Configure<PodOptions>(configuration.GetSection("Pod:Core"));

            return podOptions;
        }
    }
}

                cacheOptions.ClientMappingSlidingExpiry = TimeSpan.Parse(Configuration["Cache:ClientMappingSlidingExpiry"]);
            },
            Configuration)
                .AddXBankAuthentication()
                .AddXBankThingAuthentication()
                .AddXBankSignatureAuthentication(options =>
                {
                    options.TimestampToleranceSeconds = int.Parse(Configuration["Identity:SignatureAuthTimestampToleranceSeconds"]);
                });

            services.AddMediatR(typeof(ApplicationAssembly));

            services.AddScoped<IMcpToolCaller, McpToolCaller>();

            if(bool.Parse(Configuration["McpQueueOptions:Enabled"]))
            {
                services.AddRabbitMqServices(options =>
                {
                    Configuration.GetSection("Rabbit").Bind(options);
                });

                services.AddActiveMqServices(mcpQueueOptions =>
                {
                    mcpQueueOptions.Hosts = Configuration["McpQueueOptions:Hosts"];
                    mcpQueueOptions.Port = Configuration.GetValue<int>("McpQueueOptions:Port");
                    mcpQueueOptions.Username = Configuration["McpQueueOptions:Username"];
                    mcpQueueOptions.Password = Configuration["McpQueueOptions:Password"];
                    mcpQueueOptions.PrefetchSize = int.TryParse(Configuration["McpQueueOptions:PrefetchSize"], out int size) ? size : 1;
                    mcpQueueOptions.IncomingQueue = Configuration["McpQueueOptions:IncomingQueue"];
                    mcpQueueOptions.OutgoingQueue = Configuration["McpQueueOptions:OutgoingQueue"];
                    mcpQueueOptions.ServerName = Configuration["McpQueueOptions:ServerName"];
                    mcpQueueOptions.UseInMemory = bool.Parse(Configuration["McpQueueOptions:UseInMemory"]);
                    mcpQueueOptions.RetryInterval = int.TryParse(Configuration["McpQueueOptions:RetryInterval"], out int delay) ? delay : 0;
                    mcpQueueOptions.RetryCounts = int.TryParse(Configuration["McpQueueOptions:RetryCounts"],out int retry) ? retry : 3;
                    mcpQueueOptions.ConcurrentMessageLimit = int.TryParse(Configuration["McpQueueOptions:ConcurrentMessageLimit"],out int con) ? con : 5;
                });
            }

            services.RegisterClients(Options =>
            {
                Options.ClientTimeoutInSec = int.Parse(Configuration["XBankClients:ClientTimeoutInSec"]);
                Options.MockEnabled = Configuration.GetValue<bool?>("XBankClients:MockEnabled");
                Options.ThirdParty = new ThirdPartyOptions
                {
                    BaseUrl = Configuration["XBankClients:ThirdParty:BaseUrl"],
                    ApiKey = Configuration["XBankClients:ThirdParty:ApiKey"],
                    PrivateKey = Configuration["XBankClients:ThirdParty:PrivateKey"],
                    GetMcpThreadPath = Configuration["XBankClients:ThirdParty:GetMcpThreadPath"]
                };
            }).AddXBankHttpLogging(opt =>
            {
                opt.HttpLoggingEnabled = Configuration.GetValue<bool>("XBankClients:Logging:HttpLoggingEnabled");
                opt.LogResponseBodyOnlyOnFailure = Configuration.GetValue<bool>("XBankClients:Logging:LogResponseBodyOnlyOnFailure");
                opt.DefaultLogDetailsLevel = Configuration.GetValue<Shared.Log.LogDetailsLevel>("XBankClients:Logging:DefaultLogDetailsLevel");
                opt.DefaultResponseBodyLogThreshold = int.Parse(Configuration["XBankClients:Logging:DefaultResponseBodyLogThreshold"]);
                opt.Exceptions = Configuration.GetSection("XBankClients:Logging:Exceptions").Get<Shared.Log.LoggingExceptionsOptions[]>() ?? Array.Empty<Shared.Log.LoggingExceptionsOptions>();
                opt.FieldsToMaskInRequestBody = Configuration.GetSection("XBankClients:Logging:FieldsToMaskInRequestBody").Get<List<string>>() ?? new List<string>();
            });;

            services.AddValidatorsFromAssembly(typeof(ApplicationAssembly).Assembly);
            services.AddTransient(typeof(IPipelineBehavior<,>), typeof(ValidationBehavior<,>));

            services.AddControllers();

            services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
            services.AddSwaggerGen(options =>
            {
                options.SwaggerDoc("v1", new Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.OpenApiInfo
                {
                    Title = "XBank MCP API",
                    Version = "v1"
                });
            });
            

            services.AddMcpAuthentication();

            services.AddScoped<IJwtTokenService, JwtTokenService>();
            services.AddSingleton<SseConnectionManager>();
            services.AddUserHeadersDelegatingHandler();
            services.AddClientIpPropagationHandler();

            services.AddSingleton(typeof(IMcpRedisStore<>), typeof(McpRedisStore<>));

            services.AddKeyedSingleton<IConnectionMultiplexer>("McpRedis", (sp, key) =>
            {
                IOptions<RedisOptions> redisOptions = sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<RedisOptions>>();
                return ConnectionMultiplexer.Connect(redisOptions.Value.ToConfigurationOptions());
            });

            //Because Oauth.RedisStore is registered as Scoped
            services.AddScoped(typeof(IMcpOauthCodeMappingCacheService), typeof(McpOauthCodeMappingCacheService));

            services.AddHeaderMasker(options =>
            {
                List<string> headers = Configuration.GetSection("SensitiveHeaders:SensitiveHeaders").Get<List<string>>() ?? new List<string>();
                options.SensitiveHeaders = headers;
                options.MaskPercentage = double.Parse(Configuration["SensitiveHeaders:MaskPercentage"], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            });

            services.Configure<ForwardedHeadersOptions>(options =>
            {
                options.ForwardLimit = null;

                options.KnownProxies.Clear();
                options.KnownNetworks.Clear();

                options.ForwardedHeaders = ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedFor;
            });

            services.AddHealthChecks()
                .AddDbContextCheck<McpDbContext>(name: "Database", tags: new[] { "ready" })
                .AddRedis($"{Configuration["Redis:Endpoint"]},user={Configuration["Redis:User"]},password={Configuration["Redis:Password"]},resolveDns=True", name: "Mcp Redis", tags: new[] { "ready" })
                .AddRedis($"{Configuration["Identity:RedisUrl"]},user={Configuration["Identity:RedisUser"]},password={Configuration["Identity:RedisPassword"]},resolveDns=True", name: "Shared Redis", tags: new[] { "ready" });
        }

        public void Configure(IApplicationBuilder app, IWebHostEnvironment env)
        {
            app.UseExceptionHandler();

            // NSwag و Swashbuckle هر دو UseSwagger دارند؛ چون NSwag.AspNetCore هنوز رفرنس است، صریح صدا میزنیم
            SwaggerBuilderExtensions.UseSwagger(app);
            app.UseSwaggerUI(options => options.SwaggerEndpoint("/swagger/v1/swagger.json", "XBank MCP API v1"));

            var useHttps = Configuration.GetValue<bool>("UseHttpsRedirection");
            if (useHttps)
                app.UseHttpsRedirection();

            //todo
            app.UseCors("AllowAll");

            app.UseForwardedHeaders();

            app.UseMiddleware<BeforeAuthenticationLogMiddleware>();

            var environment = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT");
            if (environment.Equals("STAGING", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
            {
                app.UseSseJsonRpc();
            }

            if (env.IsDevelopment())
            {
                app.UseOpenApi();
                app.UseSwaggerUi3(options =>
                {
                    options.EnableTryItOut = true;
                });
            }

            app.UseRouting();

            app.UseAuthentication();
            app.UseAuthorization();

            app.UseMiddleware<RequestResponseLoggingMiddleware>();

            Console.OutputEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;

            app.UseEndpoints(endpoints =>
            {
                endpoints.MapControllers();
                endpoints.MapHealthChecks("api/health", new HealthCheckOptions()
                {
                    ResponseWriter = UIResponseWriter.WriteHealthCheckUIResponse
                })
                .RequireAuthorization(PolicyKeys.HealthCheckAdmin);
            });
        }
    }

"},{"callId":"chatcmpl-tool-8526bee03989c519","kind":"function_result","value":"using System.Text.Json;
using NUnit.Framework;
using XBank.Mcp.Application.Options;

namespace XBank.Mcp.Application.Tests.Configuration;

/// <summary>
/// قرارداد ساختار فایل‌های podSettings: تنظیمات احراز هویت در <c>Pod:Auth</c> و تنظیمات پلتفرم در <c>Pod:Core</c>؛
/// هیچ کلید قدیمی مستقیماً زیر <c>Pod</c> باقی نمانده باشد (چون <see cref="PodOptions"/> به <c>Pod:Core</c> بایند می‌شود).
/// </summary>
[TestFixture]
public class PodSettingsStructureTests
{
    private static readonly string[] SettingsFiles =
    {
        "podSettings.json",
        "podSettings.Development.json",
        "podSettings.Staging.json"
    };

    /// <summary>کلیدهای بخش Auth که ثبت سرویس Pod Identity از Configuration می‌خواند.</summary>
    private static readonly string[] AuthKeys =
    {
        "AccountServerUrl",
        "TimeoutInSec",
        "MaxConnectionPerServer",
        "PooledConnectionIdleTimeoutInMin",
        "PooledConnectionLifetimeInMin",
        "RetryCount",
        "AllowedExceptionCountBeforeBreaking",
        "DurationOfBreakInSec",
        "CircuitBreakerOptions"
    };

    /// <summary>مسیرهای توکن سرویس Thing که باید از Pod:Auth خوانده شوند (مقدارشان خارج از این ریپازیتوری تعیین می‌شود).</summary>
    private static readonly string[] AuthTokenPathKeys =
    {
        "CreateTokenPath",
        "GetTokenForThingPath",
        "GetThingPath"
    };

    [Test]
    public void PodSection_ContainsOnlyAuthAndCore([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement pod = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod");

        string[] unexpected = pod.EnumerateObject()
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .Where(name => name is not "Auth" and not "Core")
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(unexpected, Is.Empty, $"{fileName}: کلید قدیمی مستقیماً زیر Pod باقی مانده است: {string.Join(", ", unexpected)}");
        Assert.That(pod.TryGetProperty("Auth", out _), Is.True, $"{fileName}: بخش Pod:Auth وجود ندارد");
        Assert.That(pod.TryGetProperty("Core", out _), Is.True, $"{fileName}: بخش Pod:Core وجود ندارد");
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodAuth_ContainsAllIdentityKeysWithValues([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement auth = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Auth");

        foreach (string key in AuthKeys)
        {
            Assert.That(auth.TryGetProperty(key, out _), Is.True, $"{fileName}: کلید Pod:Auth:{key} تعریف نشده است");
        }

        Assert.That(auth.GetProperty("AccountServerUrl").GetString(), Is.Not.Empty,
            $"{fileName}: Pod:Auth:AccountServerUrl نباید خالی باشد");

        foreach (string key in AuthKeys.Skip(1))
        {
            if (key == "CircuitBreakerOptions")
            {
                Assert.That(auth.GetProperty(key).ValueKind, Is.EqualTo(JsonValueKind.Array),
                    $"{fileName}: Pod:Auth:{key} باید آرایه باشد");
                continue;
            }

            Assert.That(auth.GetProperty(key).GetInt32(), Is.GreaterThan(0), $"{fileName}: Pod:Auth:{key} باید مقدار مثبت داشته باشد");
        }
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodCore_BindsEveryPodOptionsProperty([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement core = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Core");

        string[] missing = typeof(PodOptions).GetProperties()
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .Where(name => !core.TryGetProperty(name, out _))
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(missing, Is.Empty,
            $"{fileName}: این ویژگی‌ها در Pod:Core نیستند و بایندینگ آن‌ها مقدار پیش‌فرض می‌گیرد: {string.Join(", ", missing)}");
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodCore_ContainsPlatformValues([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement core = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Core");

        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("PlatformServerUrl").GetString(), Is.Not.Empty,
            $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:PlatformServerUrl نباید خالی باشد");

        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("TimeoutInSec").GetInt32(), Is.GreaterThan(0), $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:TimeoutInSec باید مقدار مثبت داشته باشد");
        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("RetryCount").GetInt32(), Is.GreaterThan(0), $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:RetryCount باید مقدار مثبت داشته باشد");
        Assert.That(core.GetProperty("CircuitBreakerOptions").ValueKind, Is.EqualTo(JsonValueKind.Array),
            $"{fileName}: Pod:Core:CircuitBreakerOptions باید آرایه باشد");

        string[] paths = typeof(PodOptions).GetProperties()
            .Where(x => x.PropertyType == typeof(string) && x.Name.EndsWith("Path", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .ToArray();

        string[] emptyPaths = paths
            .Where(name => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(core.GetProperty(name).GetString()))
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(emptyPaths, Is.Empty, $"{fileName}: مسیرهای پلتفرم نباید خالی باشند: {string.Join(", ", emptyPaths)}");
    }

    [Test]
    public void PodAuth_DoesNotCarryPlatformKeys([ValueSource(nameof(SettingsFiles))] string fileName)
    {
        JsonElement auth = GetSection(Root(fileName), "Pod:Auth");

        // کلیدهای مجاز در Pod:Auth = کلیدهای Resilience سرویس Identity + مسیرهای توکن Thing
        string[] allowedKeys = AuthKeys.Concat(AuthTokenPathKeys).ToArray();

        string[] leaked = auth.EnumerateObject()
            .Select(x => x.Name)
            .Where(name => !allowedKeys.Contains(name))
            .ToArray();

        Assert.That(leaked, Is.Empty, $"{fileName}: کلیدهای پلتفرم نباید در Pod:Auth باشند: {string.Join(", ", leaked)}");
    }

    private static JsonElement Root(string fileName)
    {
        string path = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, fileName);

        Assert.That(File.Exists(path), Is.True, $"فایل تنظیمات در خروجی تست‌ها کپی نشده است: {path}");

        using JsonDocument document = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));

        return document.RootElement.Clone();
    }

    private static JsonElement GetSection(JsonElement root, string path)
    {
        JsonElement current = root;

        foreach (string part in path.Split(':'))
        {
            Assert.That(current.TryGetProperty(part, out JsonElement next), Is.True, $"بخش «{path}» یافت نشد (قطعه مفقود: {part})");

            current = next;
        }

        return current;
    }
}
